title: 第7章朱竹清的信任，七宝琉璃宗很强吗？-《斗罗V：开局绑定朱竹清，创建神级家族》
content:
第(1/3)页

    朱竹清见叶寒及时收手了，戴沐白没死，暗自松了口气。

    但她看到戴沐白被吓尿了，对他更加失望透顶。

    一个被轻易吓尿的皇子，又怎能拥有足够的勇气去面对接下来的家族淘汰制的困境。

    难怪戴沐白会弃她而去，会选择逃避。

    殊不知，朱竹清误会戴沐白了。

    并非戴沐白真的怕死，被到场吓尿了，而是他的灵魂和意识被嗜血魔剑的杀意侵袭，身体不受控制了。

    除非是经历过生死，意志特别坚定的人，或者是实力深厚，精神力强大的强者，才能抵挡杀气的侵袭。

    若是换做是普通人，现在可不是小便失禁那么简单，而是直接吓瘫痪，甚至精神错乱，成为一个疯子。

    戴沐白只是身体不受控制，小便失禁，已经算是很不错的表现了。

    “戴沐白，你真让我失望。”

    “滚吧，我不想看到你。”

    朱竹清冷漠地啐了一口，眼神中满是鄙视。

    叶寒尊重朱竹清的选择，收起嗜血魔剑，冷声喝道：“滚！”

    “你们等着！”

    戴沐白渐渐回神过来，撂下狠话，转身离开。

    他一定要让朱竹清知道背叛他的后果。

    “我们现在可以入住了吧。”

    叶寒走了回来，冷声望向经理。

    “可以！”

    “这一千金魂币，你们拿着。”

    “今晚上的损失和客房，都算我的，就算是我们交了个朋友。”

    经理点头哈腰地将一千金魂币和房间钥匙递了过来，眼神中满是怯意。

    眼前此人，实在太可怕了，他可不敢得罪。

    “不用，你照常算就是，我们也没必要跟你交朋友。”

    “竹清，我们走吧。”

    叶寒可不会随便接受别人的好意，将一千金魂币钱票放在前台，向楼梯间走去。

    朱竹清愣了片刻，跟在他屁股后面。

    进入房间，俩人被里面的布局惊呆了。

    粉红色的墙色，充满暧昧的装饰，各种让人脸红的情趣玩具等等。

    就连房间里面的气味，都带有一丝暧昧，牵动了他们的心扉。

    此时，叶寒和朱竹清都有点脸红了。

    “这里挺大的。”

    “你睡卧室里面的大床，我就在外面沙发睡一晚就行了。”

    叶寒率先开口打破了当前的寂静，随手拿了一瓶水，坐在沙发上，大口喝了起来。

    朱竹清见他挺淡定的，深吸了口气，让自己的情绪冷静了下来，走了过去，致谢道：“叶寒大哥，刚才谢谢你。”

    【叮！朱竹清忠诚度30%，奖励2000贡献值。】

    叶寒收到系统提示，淡然回道：“没事，顺手的事罢了。”

    如今，朱竹清的忠诚度达到了30%，说明已经开始获得了她的信任。

    这是一个很好的开局。

    “难道你就不想问问到底怎么回事，我跟戴沐白是什么关系吗？”

    朱竹清见他依旧很淡定，并没有询问事情原因，脸上挂满了疑惑。

    按理说，遇到这种情况，大家的潜意识中都会好奇问一下的。

    “这有啥好问的。”

    “你不想说，我问多少遍都没用。”

    “你如果想说，就算我不问，你也会说。”

    “所以，根本就没有这个必要。”

    叶寒回了一句，走到客厅的窗户前，将巨大的窗帘拉开。

    只见，外面是一个面积很大的游泳池和一片温泉池。

Page (1/3)

Zhu Zhuqing secretly breathed a sigh of relief when he saw that Ye Han had stopped in time and Dai Mubai was not dead.

But when she saw Dai Mubai was so frightened that he peed, she was even more disappointed with him.

How could a prince who was easily frightened have enough courage to face the next dilemma of the family elimination system.

No wonder Dai Mubai abandoned her and chose to escape.

“As everyone knows, Zhu Zhuqing misunderstood Dai Mubai.

It was not that Dai Mubai was really afraid of death and was scared to death by being there, but that his soul and consciousness were invaded by the killing intent of the bloodthirsty demon sword, and his body was out of control.

Only those who have experienced life and death and have a particularly strong will, or a strong man with deep strength and strong mental power, can resist the invasion of murderous intent.

If it were an ordinary person, it would not be as simple as urinary incontinence, but directly paralysis, or even insanity, and becoming a lunatic.

Dai Mubai just lost control of his body and had incontinence of urine, which was already a very good performance.

"Dai Mubai, you really disappoint me."

"Go away, I don't want to see you."

Zhu Zhuqing spat indifferently, his eyes full of contempt.

Ye Han respected Zhu Zhuqing's choice, put away the bloodthirsty demon sword, and shouted in a cold voice: "Get out!"

"You wait!"

Dai Mubai gradually came back to his senses, put down his harsh words, and turned around to leave.

He must let Zhu Zhuqing know the consequences of betraying him.

"We can move in now."

Ye Han came back and addressed the manager coldly.

"Okay!"

"You take this thousand gold soul coins."

"The damage and the guest room tonight are all mine, even if we have made friends."

The manager nodded and handed over the one thousand gold soul coins and the room key with a timid look in his eyes.

The person in front of him was really terrifying, and he didn’t dare to offend him.

“No, you can just go as usual, there’s no need for us to be friends with you.”

"Zhuqing, let's go."

Ye Han would not accept other people's kindness casually, so he placed the thousand gold soul coin ticket at the front desk and walked towards the stairwell.

Zhu Zhuqing was stunned for a moment and followed him.

Entering the room, the two of them were stunned by the layout inside.

Pink wall color, ambiguous decorations, all kinds of blushing sex toys, etc.

Even the smell in the room had a hint of ambiguity, which touched their hearts.

At this time, Ye Han and Zhu Zhuqing were both blushing.

“It’s quite big here.”

“You sleep on the big bed in the bedroom, and I’ll just sleep on the sofa outside for one night.”

Ye Han was the first to speak to break the silence. He took a bottle of water, sat on the sofa, and drank heavily.

Seeing that he was quite calm, Zhu Zhuqing took a deep breath to calm down, walked over, and thanked him: "Brother Ye Han, thank you just now."

【Ding!Zhu Zhuqing's loyalty is 30%, and he will be rewarded with 2000 contribution points.】

Ye Han received the system prompt and replied calmly: "It's okay, it's just a matter of convenience."

Now, Zhu Zhuqing’s loyalty has reached 30%, indicating that she has begun to gain her trust.

This is a good start.

"Don't you want to ask what's going on and what's the relationship between me and Dai Mubai?"

Zhu Zhuqing saw that he was still calm and did not ask the reason for the matter, his face was full of doubts.

It stands to reason that when encountering this kind of situation, everyone will subconsciously ask curious questions.

"What's there to ask?"

“If you don’t want to tell me, it’s no use how many times I ask.”

"If you want to say something, you will say it even if I don't ask."

"So, there is no need at all."

Ye Han replied, walked to the window of the living room and opened the huge curtains.

What I saw was a large swimming pool and a hot spring pool outside.
